answer: The marble cap is policed at intake and horizon reveals the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a fleet in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, because every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a nectar tag. That is 27 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
